name: npm-link-up
description:
The project configuration adheres to the schema found at https://json.schemastore.org/npm-link-up.json. It was generated automatically, as noted in the comment “Initial configuration generated automatically.”, and the current policy is not to reinstall packages on every run (alwaysReinstall = false). The system will not create a self‑link (linkToItself = false), but it does permit linking of packages (linkable = true) and the npm‑link‑up feature is enabled (npm-link-up = true). Files and directories that should be ignored during linking are node_modules and .git, while the search for modules will begin in the current directory (./) and also in the shared parent directory (../shared).

The configuration lists two local libraries, my-lib and another-lib, both of which are included in the primary list of packages to manage. Their source locations are ../my-lib (version 1.0.0) and ../another-lib (version 2.3.4) respectively. These libraries depend on the external modules lodash and express. For the development environment (env = development) debugging is turned on (debug = true).
